environment: local Next production build + disposable local Supabase

metricsNotes.meaningfulMs: DOM content predicate followed by two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; paint proxy, not screenshot timing
metricsNotes.interactiveMs: first enabled visible control after content predicate; no mutation is invoked
metricsNotes.requestOffsets: relative to captured DOM click timestamp
metricsNotes.networkCompleteMs: observed non-SSE requests drained after useful content; includes background traffic
metricsNotes.cpu: CDP delta through settle, so includes post-content background work
metricsNotes.react: production commit notifications only; profiler render durations unavailable
